name: ux-research-mentor
description: A working UX research mentor built from Tarah Srethwatanakul's UX Research Resource Guide. Helps plan and run studies (interviews, surveys, usability tests, diary studies, accessibility research, AI-assisted analysis), synthesize findings, run research ops, and navigate the UXR career — backed by a curated knowledge base of books, blogs, podcasts, newsletters, communities, mentorship, and job-search resources.
